tbesh_html:
1) beauty, splendour, glory
1a) beauty, finery (of garments, jewels)
1b) glory
1b1) of rank, renown
1b2) as attribute of God
1c) honour (or nation Israel)
1d) glorying, boasting (of individual)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: ornament (abstractly or concretely, literally or figuratively)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: beauty(-iful), bravery, comely, fair, glory(-ious), honour, majesty.

occurrences.bsb: Make holy garments for your brother Aaron, to give him glory and splendor.
occurrences.kjv: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty.

occurrences.bsb: Make tunics, sashes, and headbands for Aaron’s sons, to give them glory and splendor.
occurrences.kjv: And for Aaron’s sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.

occurrences.bsb: that He will set you high in praise and name and honor above all the nations He has made, and that you will be a holy people to the LORD your God, as He has promised.
occurrences.kjv: And to make thee high above all nations which he hath made, in praise, and in name, and in honour; and that thou mayest be an holy people unto the Lord thy God, as he hath spoken.

occurrences.bsb: “I will certainly go with you,” Deborah replied, “but the road you are taking will bring you no honor, because the LORD will be selling Sisera into the hand of a woman.” So Deborah got up and went with Barak to Kedesh,
occurrences.kjv: And she said, I will surely go with thee: notwithstanding the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honour; for the Lord shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.

occurrences.bsb: And David said, “My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent—famous and glorious throughout all lands. Therefore I must make preparations for it.” So David made lavish preparations before his death.
occurrences.kjv: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the Lord must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.

occurrences.bsb: Yours, O LORD, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the splendor and the majesty, for everything in heaven and on earth belongs to You. Yours, O LORD, is the kingdom, and You are exalted as head over all.
occurrences.kjv: Thine, O Lord, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O Lord, and thou art exalted as head above all.

occurrences.bsb: Now therefore, our God, we give You thanks, and we praise Your glorious name.
occurrences.kjv: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.

occurrences.bsb: He adorned the temple with precious stones for beauty, and its gold was from Parvaim.
occurrences.kjv: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.

occurrences.bsb: And for a full 180 days he displayed the glorious riches of his kingdom and the magnificent splendor of his greatness.
occurrences.kjv: When he shewed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honour of his excellent majesty many days, even an hundred and fourscore days.

occurrences.bsb: My mouth is filled with Your praise and with Your splendor all day long.
occurrences.kjv: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.

occurrences.bsb: He delivered His strength to captivity, and His splendor to the hand of the adversary.
occurrences.kjv: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy’s hand.

occurrences.bsb: For You are the glory of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is exalted.
occurrences.kjv: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.

occurrences.bsb: Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and beauty fill His sanctuary.
occurrences.kjv: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

occurrences.bsb: She will set a garland of grace on your head; she will present you with a crown of beauty.”
occurrences.kjv: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.

occurrences.bsb: Gray hair is a crown of glory; it is attained along the path of righteousness.
occurrences.kjv: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.

occurrences.bsb: Grandchildren are the crown of the aged, and the glory of a son is his father.
occurrences.kjv: Children’s children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.

occurrences.bsb: A man’s insight gives him patience, and his virtue is to overlook an offense.
occurrences.kjv: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.

occurrences.bsb: The glory of young men is their strength, and gray hair is the splendor of the old.
occurrences.kjv: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the gray head.

occurrences.bsb: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory, but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.
occurrences.kjv: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.

occurrences.bsb: In that day the Lord will take away their finery: their anklets and headbands and crescents;
occurrences.kjv: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet, and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,

occurrences.bsb: On that day the Branch of the LORD will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the pride and glory of Israel’s survivors.
occurrences.kjv: In that day shall the branch of the Lord be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: So when the Lord has completed all His work against Mount Zion and Jerusalem, He will say, “I will punish the king of Assyria for the fruit of his arrogant heart and the proud look in his eyes.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore it shall come to pass, that when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.

occurrences.bsb: And Babylon, the jewel of the kingdoms, the glory of the pride of the Chaldeans, will be overthrown by God like Sodom and Gomorrah.
occurrences.kjv: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

occurrences.bsb: Those who made Cush their hope and Egypt their boast will be dismayed and ashamed.
occurrences.kjv: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.

occurrences.bsb: Woe to the majestic crown of Ephraim’s drunkards, to the fading flower of his glorious splendor, set on the summit above the fertile valley, the pride of those overcome by wine.
occurrences.kjv: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty is a fading flower, which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!

occurrences.bsb: The fading flower of his beautiful splendor, set on the summit above the fertile valley, will be like a ripe fig before the summer harvest: Whoever sees it will take it in his hand and swallow it.
occurrences.kjv: And the glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower, and as the hasty fruit before the summer; which when he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.

occurrences.bsb: On that day the LORD of Hosts will be a crown of glory, a diadem of splendor to the remnant of His people,
occurrences.kjv: In that day shall the Lord of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people,

occurrences.bsb: The woodworker extends a measuring line; he marks it out with a stylus; he shapes it with chisels and outlines it with a compass. He fashions it in the likeness of man, like man in all his glory, that it may dwell in a shrine.
occurrences.kjv: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.

occurrences.bsb: I am bringing My righteousness near; it is not far away, and My salvation will not be delayed. I will grant salvation to Zion and adorn Israel with My splendor.
occurrences.kjv: I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.

occurrences.bsb: Awake, awake, clothe yourself with strength, O Zion! Put on your garments of splendor, O Jerusalem, holy city! For the uncircumcised and unclean will no longer enter you.
occurrences.kjv: Awake, awake; put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.

occurrences.bsb: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered to you; the rams of Nebaioth will serve you and go up on My altar with acceptance; I will adorn My glorious house.
occurrences.kjv: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.

occurrences.bsb: No longer will the sun be your light by day, nor the brightness of the moon shine on your night; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your splendor.
occurrences.kjv: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but the Lord shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.

occurrences.bsb: You will be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, a royal diadem in the palm of your God.
occurrences.kjv: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the Lord, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.

occurrences.bsb: who sent His glorious arm to lead them by the right hand of Moses, who divided the waters before them to gain for Himself everlasting renown,
occurrences.kjv: That led them by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?

occurrences.bsb: Like cattle going down to the valley, the Spirit of the LORD gave them rest. You led Your people this way to make for Yourself a glorious name.
occurrences.kjv: As a beast goeth down into the valley, the Spirit of the Lord caused him to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.

occurrences.bsb: Look down from heaven and see, from Your holy and glorious habitation. Where are Your zeal and might? Your yearning and compassion for me are restrained.
occurrences.kjv: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where is thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained?

occurrences.bsb: Our holy and beautiful temple, where our fathers praised You, has been burned with fire, and all that was dear to us lies in ruins.
occurrences.kjv: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.

occurrences.bsb: For just as a loincloth clings to a man’s waist, so I have made the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah cling to Me, declares the LORD, so that they might be My people for My renown and praise and glory. But they did not listen.
occurrences.kjv: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith the Lord; that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.

occurrences.bsb: Say to the king and to the queen mother: “Take a lowly seat, for your glorious crowns have fallen from your heads.”
occurrences.kjv: Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down, even the crown of your glory.

occurrences.bsb: Lift up your eyes and see those coming from the north. Where is the flock entrusted to you, the sheep that were your pride?
occurrences.kjv: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given thee, thy beautiful flock?

occurrences.bsb: So this city will bring Me renown, joy, praise, and glory before all the nations of the earth, who will hear of all the good I do for it. They will tremble in awe because of all the goodness and prosperity that I will provide for it.
occurrences.kjv: And it shall be to me a name of joy, a praise and an honour before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do unto them: and they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the prosperity that I procure unto it.

occurrences.bsb: Mourn for him, all you who surround him, everyone who knows his name; tell how the mighty scepter is shattered—the glorious staff!
occurrences.kjv: All ye that are about him, bemoan him; and all ye that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, and the beautiful rod!

occurrences.bsb: How the Lord has covered the Daughter of Zion with the cloud of His anger! He has cast the glory of Israel from heaven to earth. He has abandoned His footstool in the day of His anger.
occurrences.kjv: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!

occurrences.bsb: I put a ring in your nose, earrings on your ears, and a beautiful crown upon your head.
occurrences.kjv: And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head.

occurrences.bsb: You also took the fine jewelry of gold and silver I had given you, and you made male idols with which to prostitute yourself.
occurrences.kjv: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest to thyself images of men, and didst commit whoredom with them,

occurrences.bsb: Then I will deliver you into the hands of your lovers, and they will level your mounds and tear down your lofty shrines. They will strip off your clothes, take your fine jewelry, and leave you naked and bare.
occurrences.kjv: And I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thine eminent place, and shall break down thy high places: they shall strip thee also of thy clothes, and shall take thy fair jewels, and leave thee naked and bare.

occurrences.bsb: They will strip off your clothes and take your fine jewelry.
occurrences.kjv: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.

occurrences.bsb: accompanied by the sound of a carefree crowd. Drunkards were brought in from the desert along with men from the rabble, who put bracelets on your wrists and beautiful crowns on your head.
occurrences.kjv: And a voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with the men of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.

occurrences.bsb: And you, son of man, know that on the day I take away their stronghold, their pride and joy—the desire of their eyes which uplifted their souls—and their sons and daughters as well,
occurrences.kjv: Also, thou son of man, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,

occurrences.bsb: The LORD will save the tents of Judah first, so that the glory of the house of David and of the people of Jerusalem may not be greater than that of Judah.
occurrences.kjv: The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Judah.
